name: founder_raw
description: Authentic founder talking-head: minimal grade, karaoke-line captions, gentle punch-ins, and NO SFX. Looks like a real person talking to camera, not a produced ad. Trust over polish.

grade.notes: subtle = barely-there cleanup. Keep skin tones and the room honest — over-grading kills the 'this is real' feeling.

captions.notes: Whole-line captions with the active word highlighted (the familiar, readable talking-head style). Static highlight, no pop — calm and legible.

punch_in.notes: Gentle 8% push on emphasis lines only. Mostly static framing — the punch is a seasoning, not the dish.

pacing.notes: Tighten dead air and false starts, jump-cut the rambles, but keep the natural rhythm of speech. Dead-air speed-up is a good fit here over hard removal.

transition.notes: Hard cuts only. A transition would make it feel produced, which defeats the 'raw' premise.

sfx.notes: No SFX. Silence between words is part of the authenticity.

notes: The 'just a founder talking' look — Counza's default for trust-building, build-in-public, and story content. The whole point is that it does NOT look edited. Resist adding motion, SFX, or grade.
